data.name: Nubla
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘nubal’, meaning ‘light’ or ‘grace’. Nubla is a name of spiritual significance in Islamic culture, symbolizing the inner light that illuminates the path to knowledge and wisdom. It is also a name of grace and beauty, evoking images of the radiant moon and the gentle breeze.
